```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false 
#| warning: false
library(bib2df)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(glue)

pubs <- bib2df("publications/publications.bib") |>
  mutate(
    month_num = coalesce(
      match(str_to_title(str_sub(MONTH, 1, 3)), month.abb),
      suppressWarnings(as.integer(MONTH)),
      0L
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(YEAR), desc(month_num))

my_name <- "Palomo-Munoz, Gabriela"

fmt_entry <- function(row) {
  authors <- row$AUTHOR[[1]]
  is_me   <- str_detect(authors, regex(my_name, ignore_case = TRUE))
  authors <- if_else(is_me, paste0("**", authors, "**"), authors)
  authors <- paste(authors, collapse = ", ")

  title <- str_remove_all(row$TITLE, "[{}]")
  venue <- coalesce(row$JOURNAL, row$BOOKTITLE, "")

  doi <- if (!is.na(row$DOI)) {
    d <- str_remove(row$DOI, "^https?://(dx\\.)?doi\\.org/")
    glue(" <https://doi.org/{d}>")
  } else ""

  glue("{authors} ({row$YEAR}). {title}. *{venue}*.{doi}")
}

for (y in unique(pubs$YEAR)) {
  cat("\n\n## ", y, "\n\n", sep = "")
  yr <- filter(pubs, YEAR == y)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(yr))) {
    cat("- ", fmt_entry(yr[i, ]), "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
